mapper.insert: insert into CHB_AST_VAL ( VAL_ID, ISSUE_PARTY_ID, ASSET_CODE, VAL_DATE, UNIT_VAL_NET, UNIT_VAL_TOTAL, REMARK, DATASOURCE, STATUS, WORKFLOW_ID, ORG_CODE, DEPT_CODE, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME ) values ( #{valId,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{issuePartyId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{assetCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{valDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{unitValNet,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{unitValTotal,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{datasource,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{workflowId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{orgCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{deptCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW(), #{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW() )
mapper.select:
select assetCode, valDate, ROUND(unitValNet,4) unitValNet, ROUND(unitValTotal,4) unitValTotal from (select assetbasis.assetCode, assetbasis.valueDate valDate, ifnull(price.PRICE,1) * (case typex.SRCFIELD1 when 'NOMONEYFOUND' then (costAmt+floatingpl)/posAmt when 'MONEYFOUND' then (case info.TRM_FUND_TYPE when '01' then 100 when '05' then 0.01 else 1 end) when 'STOCK' then (costAmt+floatingpl)/posAmt when 'DERIVATIVE' then (costAmt+floatingpl) when 'OPTION' then (costAmt+floatingpl) else (case assetbasis.valueDate when assetbasis.mdate then 100 else 100*costAmt/posAmt end) end) unitValNet, ifnull(price.PRICE,1) * (case typex.SRCFIELD1 when 'MONEYFOUND' then (costAmt+floatingpl+intincexp)/posAmt when 'NOMONEYFOUND' then (costAmt+floatingpl)/posAmt when 'STOCK' then (costAmt+floatingpl+intincexp)/posAmt when 'DERIVATIVE' then (costAmt+floatingpl+intincexp) when 'OPTION' then (costAmt+floatingpl+intincexp) else (case assetbasis.valueDate when assetbasis.mdate then 100 else 100*(costAmt+floatingpl+intincexp)/posAmt end) end) unitValTotal from (select ASSET_ID assetCode, VALUE_DATE valueDate, CCY ccy, MDATE mdate, sum(ifnull(TDY_COST_AMT,0)) costAmt, sum(ifnull(TDY_INTINCEXP,0)) intincexp, sum(ifnull(POS_AMT,0)) posAmt, sum(ifnull(TDY_FLOAT_INGPL,0)) floatingpl
FROM CHB_ASSETS_BASIS_DATA basis
FROM CHB_ASSETS_BASIS_DATA_NOBTM basis
where DATE_FORMAT(VALUE_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') = #{generateDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and basis.status !='D' and pos_amt != 0 and pos_amt is not null group by ASSET_ID,VALUE_DATE,MDATE,CCY) assetbasis left join CHB_ASSET_INFO info on info.ASSET_CODE = assetbasis.assetCode left join ( SELECT BASIS_CYY CCY,
OPEN_PRICE PRICE CLOSE_PRICE PRICE HIGH_PRICE PRICE LOW_PRICE PRICE MID_PRICE PRICE
FROM ( select bc.EXCHARGE_CODE, bc.TRADE_DATE, bc.DATASOURCE_TYPE, bc.OPEN_PRICE, bc.CLOSE_PRICE, bc.HIGH_PRICE, bc.LOW_PRICE, bc.MID_PRICE, bc.BASIS_CYY, bc.QUOT_CYY, bc.QUOT_UNIT, bc.INPUT_TYPE, bc.CREATE_USER, bc.CREATE_DEPT, bc.CREATE_TIME, bc.UPDATE_USER, bc.UPDATE_TIME, rn from ( SELECT result.* FROM ( SELECT tmp.*, @rownum := @rownum + 1 row, IF( ( @BASIS_CYY = tmp.BASIS_CYY ), @rank := @rank + 1, @rank := 1 ) AS rn, @BASIS_CYY := tmp.BASIS_CYY FROM ( SELECT bc.* FROM MST_EXCHARGE_QUOTE bc where DATE_FORMAT(bc.TRADE_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') <= #{generateDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and QUOT_CYY='CNY' and DATASOURCE_TYPE='SAFE' ORDER BY TRADE_DATE DESC ) tmp, (SELECT @rownum := 0, @BASIS_CYY := null, @rank := 0) a ) result ) bc ) t2 WHERE rn=1 ) price on price.CCY = assetbasis.CCY left join CHB_TYPE_MAPPING_EX typex on typex.OBJFIELD1 = info.ORG_ASSET_TYPE1 and ((typex.OBJFIELD2 = info.ORG_ASSET_TYPE2) or typex.OBJFIELD2 is null) and ((typex.OBJFIELD3 = info.TRM_FUND_TYPE) or typex.OBJFIELD3 is null) and typex.MAPPINGCODE='ASSETBASISTYPE' where 1=1 and (assetbasis.posAmt <> 0 or assetbasis.valueDate=assetbasis.mdate) and assetbasis.assetCode is not null and typex.MAPPINGCODE is not null ) t1 where unitValNet is not null
